newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London static, Tokyo on holiday.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London static, Tokyo on holiday.

text.p: Japanese shares were at a virtual standstill on Thursday due to the Vernal Equinox public holiday in Japan, which closed Tokyo's financial markets, dealers here said.
"I haven't done a single bargain all day. There is nothing going on," one dealer said.
On Wednesday, the Nikkei-225 index closed 48.51 points higher to 18,493.71. The Japanese financial markets resume normal operations on Friday, March 21.
